Use case: background-edit / identity-preserve. Edit image1 into a cinematic hero keyframe for a high-budget LIVE-ACTION historical narrative game trailer. Image1 locks the EXACT same Chinese male actor face, expression, tall black ribbed crown, dark indigo woven Han robe, beige inner collar, right hand offering bronze seal, left hand by waist. Image2 locks the corrected25mm square brown-gray private bronze seal,15mm total height, small pierced nose knob and faded short reddish-brown cord. Preserve actor identity, anatomically correct hands and scale; change the empty background into the designed tent set, with a modest framing expansion only as needed. One single full-frame16:9 landscape photograph, not an illustration/game-engine screenshot. No text, no watermark, no borders.

DESIGN: A spacious but believable late-Han military command tent recalled in a dream, an expensive physical period film set. Natural dark charcoal-brown heavy woven tent fabric, thick timber ridge/support poles and taut rope joints, roof cloth receding in visible diagonals, several layers of curtains creating depth. Far interior gently falls into dark shadow, never a glowing supernatural void. Soft out-of-focus near tent flap along far left edge and a little upper right edge frames the character, without covering his face or hand. Do not make it a stone palace or imperial throne room.

Behind the man by about1.5 to2m is a LOW black-brown lacquered wooden writing table (low legs, roughly35cm high, for floor seating, NOT a modern tall desk), seen on either side of his lower body. Few carefully spaced functional items: one partly unrolled bundle of bamboo slips with no readable writing, one closed slip roll, a simple rectangular lidded document box, a modest shallow bronze oil lamp at far background edge with tiny flame. No tall bookcases, chairs, paper mountain, feather fan, weapons wall or ceremonial altar.

Behind that table stands a plain rectangular wooden lacquer screen with simple feet. Screen roughly1.6m tall and2m wide, composed of a few practical timber panels, with restrained joinery and NO gold frame, carved dragons or luxurious royal fittings. Decorate its black lacquer field with dark vermilion HAND-PAINTED HAN-INSPIRED PAIRED PHOENIX-BIRD AND CLOUD-SCROLL MOTIFS. Form language: two slender side-profile crested birds, gently S-curved neck/body, one foot lifted, long single curling tail-feathers merging with flowing cloud curls, abstract rhythmic brush-painted lines; based on Han lacquer bird ornament. The motifs are physically flat pigment with worn edges and subtle lacquer sheen. Readable enough to give this image its distinctive visual identity, but lower contrast than the face. Bird heads and some tail curls emerge to either side of the figure's shoulders and arms; keep motif below crown and offset so it does NOT form a halo or wings attached to the actor. Do NOT use modern fire phoenix, western eagle heraldry, huge photoreal bird, peacock fan tail, imperial Qing phoenix, red bird on a round disk, giant magical glyph or gold symbol. This is evocative set decoration, not a military flag or historical family crest. No resurrecting fire or phoenix effects.

COMPOSITION: Player first-person eye height with50mm normal-lens perspective, front medium-wide from complete crown with clear headroom to approximately mid-thigh, strong central presence, face and extended right palm carrying seal clearly readable. Keep the offered hand in the lower-left central area, open foreground access so the player could receive seal, no tabletop between hand and camera. Camera and gaze human, no extreme low angle. Roof/curtain perspective lines and the table/screen create monumental depth, but scale remains intimate enough to read the man's eyes. Background screen not overblurred: viewer can distinguish a painted Han bird and lacquer grain, yet it does not compete with facial detail.

LIGHT/REALISM: Main light is soft neutral daylight-balanced light around5500K through unseen tent opening at camera-left, directional shape on real skin, crown, sleeve and bronze. Dark readable shadows, no overall yellow cast, natural muted skin, subtly blue indigo cloth. Tiny oil lamp creates only a local warm point far away, not orange face illumination. Very faint believable atmospheric depth in farther tent only, no thick fog, rays or floating particle glitter. Filmic highlight rolloff, delicate35mm grain, gentle background optical falloff with medium usable depth of field. Visible skin pores and sparse individual facial hair without oversharp etched wrinkles, natural eyelid moisture, woven fibers with weight, rubbed lacquer edges, old wood fibers, bronze dark recesses and modest polish on handled edges. Authentic physical materials, restrained sorrowful resolve, a human making an urgent intimate promise. No beauty filter, doll/plastic skin, CGI/render/gameengine look, oversaturation, modern furniture, armor, extras, blood, rain or anachronisms. Preserve the25mm private seal and exact person's identity throughout.
